claims: Continue invasive mechanical ventilation with current settings, targeting Richmond-RAS 0 and monitoring airway pressures and minute volume.
Repeat arterial blood gas to reassess acid-base status and oxygenation given prior pH 7.30, base excess -5, and PaO2 455 mmHg on FiO2 40%.
Recheck serum magnesium and replace if still low, given prior magnesium 1.3 mg/dL and active magnesium sulfate administration.
Recheck serum calcium and continue calcium replacement as needed, given prior total calcium 7.6–7.8 mg/dL and active calcium gluconate administration.
Monitor and manage pain with the existing multimodal analgesia plan, reassessing frequently given reported worst pain 10.
Continue ampicillin-sulbactam and monitor for clinical response, given leukocytosis (WBC 15.1–16.2 K/uL) and temperature up to 101°F.
Perform oral care with chlorhexidine gluconate 0.12% oral rinse to reduce ventilator-associated pneumonia risk.
Maintain head-of-bed elevation and continue subglottic suctioning to reduce aspiration risk.
Monitor arterial line and invasive line sites, including dressing integrity and zero/calibration, and continue ST segment monitoring.
Reassess volume status and electrolytes with repeat basic metabolic panel, given prior anion gap 21, bicarbonate 16, and active electrolyte replacement.
